articles.title: Risk of transmission of amyloid β pathology via transfused blood products
articles.authors: Banerjee G, Edgren G, Zhao J, Ferguson NM, Harvala H, Hope J, Jackson GS, Lowry PJ, et al.

abstract.text: Seeded protein misfolding and aggregation are relevant to many neurodegenerative diseases. The archetype are prions: protein-only infectious agents that cause fatal neurodegenerative diseases including Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD). The recent recognition of iatrogenic amyloid β cerebral amyloid angiopathy (CAA) and Alzheimer's disease, caused by inadvertent seeding of amyloid β pathology following historical medical procedures, raises concerns that these conditions might also be transmitted via blood components and products, as was the case in rare instances for variant CJD. Recent epidemiological data showing the apparent transmission of haemorrhage risk between blood donors and recipients raise the possibility of blood-based CAA transmission. In this Viewpoint, we review the evidence for amyloid β transmission, provide an overview of relevant prion biology, and consider the circumstances under which bloodborne prion transmission has previously occurred. We discuss the implications for blood transfusion services, particularly in light of the UK Infected Blood Inquiry, and the key questions that need to be addressed to better quantify transfusion-related risk.

articles.title: Liver resection after atezolizumab and bevacizumab versus maintenance therapy for locally advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (TALENTOP): a multicentre, open-label, randomised, phase 3 trial
articles.authors: Sun HC, Zhu XD, Shen F, Song TQ, Bai XL, Zeng YY, Chen MS, Huang ZY, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Resection might offer additional benefit in patients with advanced-stage hepatocellular carcinoma treated with systemic therapy. However, high-quality evidence supporting the procedure is absent. We aimed to establish whether resection can provide survival benefit in patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma who respond to systemic therapy.
abstract.textZh: 切除可能為接受全身治療的晚期肝細胞癌患者帶來額外的益處。然而，缺乏支持該程序的高質量證據。我們旨在確定切除是否能為對全身治療有反應的晚期肝細胞癌患者提供生存期益處。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this randomised, open-label, multicentre, phase 3 trial, we recruited treatment-naive patients with hepatocellular carcinoma, macrovascular invasion, and no extrahepatic metastasis from 24 hospitals in China. These patients were treated in the induction phase with three cycles of intravenous atezolizumab (1200 mg every 3 weeks) plus intravenous bevacizumab (15 mg/kg bodyweight every 3 weeks) and one cycle of atezolizumab monotherapy. Patients who completed the induction phase, had a partial response or stable disease according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) version 1.1, and were considered feasible for resection were randomly assigned (1:1) to undergo surgical resection followed by 12 months of atezolizumab plus bevacizumab initiated 4-6 weeks after surgery (ie, the surgery group), or to maintenance atezolizumab plus bevacizumab until loss of clinical benefit or intolerable toxicity (the maintenance therapy group). Randomisation was by computer-generated sequence with permuted blocks via a central interactive web response system, stratified by tumour response and Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status. Treatment administered to patients was not masked. The primary endpoint was time to treatment failure, assessed by an independent review facility and analysed by intention to treat. Time to treatment failure was defined as the time from randomisation to the first documented treatment failure (ie, local recurrence or disease progression according to RECIST 1.1, emergence of extrahepatic spread, or death). This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT04649489) and is ongoing.

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between April 4, 2021, and July 18, 2024, a total of 489 patients were enrolled in the induction phase. Of them, 201 were randomly assigned to the surgery group (n=101; 93 male, eight female) or the maintenance therapy group (n=100; 87 male, 13 female). After a median follow-up of 18·4 months, the median time to treatment failure was 20·4 months in the surgery group and 11·8 months in the maintenance therapy group (hazard ratio 0·60, 95% CI 0·39-0·91; p=0·015). Grade 3 or 4 treatment-related adverse events occurred in 32 (39%) of 83 patients in the surgery group and 21 (21%) of 100 in the maintenance therapy group, the most common of which were increased alanine aminotransferase (seven patients [8%] in the surgery group vs one [1%] in the maintenance therapy group), reduced platelet count (seven [8%] vs three [3%]), and proteinuria (three [4%] vs seven [7%]). Two treatment-related deaths occurred in the surgery group due to abnormal liver function (considered related to atezolizumab) and liver failure (considered related to atezolizumab, bevacizumab, or surgery).

articles.title: Multivessel coronary artery bypass grafting via small thoracotomy versus sternotomy (MIST): an investigator-initiated, international, open-label, randomised controlled trial
articles.authors: Ruel M, Nambala S, Guo MH, Verevkin A, Rabindranauth P, Kikuchi K, Davierwala PM, Lemma M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) is a common but invasive operation traditionally performed through a median sternotomy. Minimally invasive cardiac surgery (MICS) CABG via small thoracotomy might improve postoperative recovery, but randomised evidence has been scarce. We aimed to compare patient-reported recovery after MICS CABG versus sternotomy CABG in patients with multivessel coronary artery disease and to describe clinical and safety outcomes.
abstract.textZh: 冠狀動脈旁路移植（ CABG ）是傳統上通過正中胸骨切開術進行的常見但侵入性手術。通過小開胸微創心臟手術（ MICS ） CABG可能會改善術後恢復，但隨機證據很少。我們旨在比較多支冠狀動脈疾病患者MICS CABG與胸骨切開CABG後患者報告的恢復情況，並描述臨牀和安全性結果。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: MIST was an investigator-initiated, international, open-label, randomised controlled trial done at seven centres (four academic hospitals and three community hospitals) in Canada, India, China, Germany, the USA, and Japan. Patients referred to participating surgeons for CABG were eligible if they were aged 18 years or older; had angiographically confirmed multivessel coronary artery disease, defined as lesions of at least 70% stenosis in at least two major epicardial vessels and at least two separate coronary artery territories (left anterior descending artery, left circumflex artery, or right coronary artery) or left main coronary stenosis of 50% or more; and were suitable for coronary surgery both with sternotomy CABG and MICS CABG. Patients who were haemodynamically compromised, had contraindications to either approach, had had previous cardiac surgery, or required concomitant procedures were excluded. Eligible patients were randomly assigned (1:1) to MICS CABG or sternotomy CABG by a central, web-based system, stratified by centre, with block sizes of four and six. The primary endpoint was patient-reported physical recovery at 1 month, assessed by the 36-item Short Form Health Survey Physical Component Summary (SF-36 PCS) score. The primary analysis was by intention to treat; safety analyses were done according to treatment received. Missing 1-month questionnaire data were handled by multiple imputation. The trial was registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT03447938), and is closed to recruitment.

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Aug 24, 2018, and Nov 26, 2024, 176 patients were enrolled, 170 of whom were randomly assigned to MICS CABG (n=86) or sternotomy CABG (n=84). The median age of patients was 67·0 years (IQR 61·0-72·0), 154 (91%) patients were male, and 16 (9%) were female. At 1 month after surgery, SF-36 PCS scores were significantly higher in the MICS CABG group than in the sternotomy CABG group (mean 45·1 [SD 8·0] vs 42·2 [9·1]; mean difference 2·9 [95% CI 0·3-5·5]; p=0·031). Clinical and safety follow-up at 1 month was complete in all patients; 12-month clinical and safety follow-up was complete in all except three patients in the sternotomy CABG group. Up to 12 months after surgery, there were no deaths or strokes in either group; one major adverse cardiac or cerebrovascular event occurred in the MICS CABG group before 1 month and none in the sternotomy CABG group.

articles.title: Psoriasis
articles.authors: Eder L, Perez-Chada L, Liao W, Merola JF

abstract.text: Psoriasis is a common, chronic, immune-mediated skin disease affecting more than 40 million individuals worldwide. Psoriasis, along with psoriatic arthritis, are part of a broader psoriatic disease spectrum, and present with inflammatory skin and musculoskeletal manifestations driven by shared genetic, environmental, and immunological mechanisms. Skin psoriasis presents with diverse clinical phenotypes, including chronic plaque psoriasis, guttate, palmoplantar, erythrodermic, and pustular forms. Beyond cutaneous manifestations, psoriasis is associated with a substantial psychosocial burden and a wide range of comorbidities, including mental health disorders and cardio-metabolic diseases. Key psoriasis risk factors include genetic polymorphisms (most notably HLA-C*06:02), obesity, and environmental factors such as trauma, infections, and specific medications. Advances in understanding the key role of the IL-23-IL-17 inflammatory axis and related immunogenetic pathways have redefined psoriasis as a complex immune disorder, leading to the development of highly effective targeted biologic and small-molecule therapies that modulate cytokine signalling and intracellular pathways, offering improved disease control across cutaneous and musculoskeletal domains.

articles.title: Deramiocel heart-derived cellular therapy in advanced Duchenne muscular dystrophy (HOPE-3): a phase 3, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
articles.authors: McDonald CM, Villa C, Soslow JH, Maharry K, Hogan N, Binks M, Berth KC, Elliott KA, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) is an X-linked genetic disease of skeletal and cardiac muscle that leads to loss of ambulation and premature death due to progressive myopathy and cardiomyopathy. Deramiocel, a heart-derived cellular therapy consisting of human allogeneic cardiosphere-derived cells, improved cardiac and skeletal muscle function in phase 1-2 studies of DMD. Our aim was to assess the efficacy and safety of deramiocel in advanced DMD and support the findings of HOPE-2.
abstract.textZh: Duchenne肌肉萎縮症（ DMD ）是一種X連結的骨骼和心臟肌肉遺傳疾病，由於進行性肌病和心肌病，導致失去行走能力和過早死亡。Deramiocel是一種心臟衍生的細胞療法，由人類同種異體心臟球衍生的細胞組成，在DMD的1-2期研究中改善了心臟和骨骼肌的功能。我們的目標是評估deramiocel在晚期DMD中的有效性和安全性，並支持HOPE-2的發現。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: HOPE-3, a phase 3, multicentre, randomised (1:1), double-blind, placebo-controlled study, included participants aged 10 years or older with DMD. Investigational product was infused intravenously every 3 months in outpatient settings. Skeletal and cardiac function was evaluated at 12 months. The primary endpoint was total Performance of the Upper Limb 2.0 (PUL2.0) percentage change from baseline. The trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT05126758).
abstract.textZh: HOPE-3 ，一項3期、多中心、隨機(1: 1)、雙盲、安慰劑對照的研究，包括10歲或以上的DMD參與者。在門診情況下，每3個月靜脈注射一次研究藥物。在12個月時評估骨骼和心臟功能。主要評估指標為上肢2.0的總體能(PUL2.0)相對於基線的百分比變化。該試驗已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT05126758 ）註冊。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between June 22, 2022, and May 28, 2024, 139 participants were screened, of whom 106 were randomly assigned to deramiocel (n=54) or placebo (n=52), and included in the intention-to-treat population. The primary endpoint showed significant improvements in the deramiocel group versus placebo. For total PUL2.0, least-squares mean percentage change at 12 months favoured deramiocel by 4·55% (95% CI 0·47-8·63; p=0·029). The safety profile of deramiocel was similar to that of placebo.

abstract.text: Deramiocel safely slows disease progression in advanced DMD, preserving skeletal muscle function. Administered quarterly in a simple outpatient regimen, deramiocel is a promising treatment for DMD, agnostic to the precise underlying genetic lesion.

articles.authors: Silverberg JI, Rosmarin D, Bieber T, Chovatiya R, Gooderham M, Gkalpakiotis S, Reich A, Murrell DF, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Rezpegaldesleukin is an interleukin-2 receptor agonist that selectively expands and enhances the function of regulatory T cells (Tregs), offering a novel therapeutic approach for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases such as atopic dermatitis. We aimed to compare the efficacy and safety analyses of rezpegaldesleukin with placebo in adults with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis naive to biological treatments.
abstract.textZh: Rezpegaldesleukin是一種白介素-2受體激動劑，可選擇性地擴大和增強調節性T細胞（ Treg ）的功能，為自身免疫和炎症性疾病（如特應性皮炎）提供新的治療方法。我們旨在比較rezpegaldesleukin與安慰劑在中度至重度原發性特應性皮炎成人中的療效和安全性分析。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: REZOLVE-AD was a phase 2b, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled study conducted in 107 community research centres or hospitals in ten countries (Australia, Bulgaria, Canada, Croatia, Czechia, Germany, Hungary, Poland, Spain, and the USA). Eligible patients were adults (aged 18 years or older) with confirmed atopic dermatitis (American Academy of Dermatology Consensus Criteria) diagnosed at least 12 months before enrolment, with moderate-to-severe disease activity defined by an Eczema Area and Severity Index (EASI) score of at least 16·0, validated Investigator Global Assessment for Atopic Dermatitis (vIGA-AD) score of at least 3 (moderate), and at least 10% affected body surface area. Patients were randomly allocated (3:3:3:2) to receive subcutaneous rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg or rezpegaldesleukin 18 μg/kg every 2 weeks, rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg every 4 weeks, or placebo for 16 weeks during the induction period. Randomisation was done by an independent vendor using Randomisation and Trial Supply Management methodology via an interactive response system and was stratified by baseline disease severity (vIGA-AD 3 [moderate] vs 4 [severe]) and geographical region (North America vs rest of world). All patients, investigators, and those assessing outcomes were masked to treatment assignment. Outcomes for the induction period were assessed through week 16 and are included in this report. The primary endpoint was percentage change from baseline in EASI score at week 16. Efficacy and safety analyses were conducted in all randomly assigned patients exposed to study treatment, excluding those enrolled at two sites closed due to Good Clinical Practice non-compliance, both of which received notification of closure approximately 300 days before database lock. All missing data were imputed with multiple imputation. The trial was registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT06136741).

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: 398 patients were enrolled between Nov 15, 2023, and Jan 9, 2025. A total of 393 patients were analysed (104 in the rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg every 2 weeks group, 106 in the rezpegaldesleukin 18 μg/kg every 2 weeks group, 110 in the rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg every 4 weeks group, and 73 in the placebo group); 203 (52%) patients were female and 190 (48%) were male. All three rezpegaldesleukin groups met the primary endpoint. Rezpegaldesleukin showed dose-dependent improvements compared with placebo in mean percentage change in EASI from baseline at week 16: -61% (SE 3·8) for rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg every 2 weeks, -58% (3·8) for rezpegaldesleukin 18 μg/kg every 2 weeks, and -53% (3·7) for rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg every 4 weeks versus -31% (4·5) for placebo. Treatment differences versus placebo were -30 percentage points (95% CI -41·3 to -18·0; p<0·0001) for rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg every 2 weeks, -27 percentage points (-38·5 to -15·7; p<0·0001) for rezpegaldesleukin 18 μg/kg every 2 weeks, and -22 percentage points (-33·3 to -10·3; p=0·0002) for rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg every 4 weeks. Treatment-emergent adverse events observed in at least 5% of rezpegaldesleukin-treated patients (n=320) and greater than placebo (n=73) included injection-site reaction (223 [70%] vs three [4%]), eosinophilia (25 [8%] vs two [3%]), pyrexia (20 [6%] vs two [3%]), headache (20 [6%] vs three [4%]), upper respiratory tract infections (19 [6%] vs four [5%]), and arthralgia (16 [5%] vs one [1%]). Nearly all (>99%) injection-site reactions were mild to moderate in severity and resolved. There was no evidence of an increased risk of serious or severe adverse events, and no deaths were reported during the induction period.

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Over the 16-week induction period, rezpegaldesleukin treatment resulted in significant and clinically meaningful improvements across multiple clinical endpoints, including the primary endpoint of EASI percentage change from baseline, in comparison with placebo. Rezpegaldesleukin had a clinically favourable adverse event profile in adult patients with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, supporting its further development as a novel Treg-enhancing biological treatment.

articles.title: Myeloproliferative Neoplasms
articles.authors: Plo I, Vainchenker W

abstract.text: Classic myeloproliferative neoplasms, including essential thrombocythemia, polycythemia vera, and primary myelofibrosis, are chronic, clonal hematopoietic stem-cell disorders. These disorders are driven by gain-of-function mutations in the genes Janus kinase 2 (JAK2), calreticulin (CALR), or the thrombopoietin receptor (MPL) that activate cytokine signaling. These mutations arise decades before clinical disease develops and confer a clonal advantage that is further shaped by comutations in epigenetic, splicing, or signaling genes. Inflammation enhances clonal dominance, favoring the development of myelofibrosis and thrombotic complications. Disease evolution may culminate in secondary acute myeloid leukemia, which has a poor prognosis. Current therapies primarily aim to control symptoms, thrombosis, and splenomegaly, but they have limited disease-modifying effects, except for pegylated interferon alfa and JAK2 inhibitors in some patients. Emerging therapies that selectively target mutant CALR and JAK2 V617F using immunotherapy and selective inhibitors could be a breakthrough in the treatment of persons with myeloproliferative neoplasms, with the expectation of achieving durable disease modification and potentially clonal eradication.
abstract.textZh: 典型的骨髓增生性腫瘤，包括原發性血小板增多症、真性紅血球增多症和原發性骨髓纖維化，是慢性、克隆性造血幹細胞疾病。 這些疾病是由激活細胞因子信號的基因Janus激酶2 （ JAK2 ）、鈣化蛋白（ CALR ）或血小板生成素受體（ MPL ）的功能獲得突變驅動的。 這些突變在臨牀疾病發展前數十年出現，並賦予克隆優勢，進一步由表觀遺傳、剪接或信號基因的突變塑造。 炎症增強克隆優勢，有利於骨髓纖維化和血栓性併發症的發展。 疾病進化可能導致繼發性急性骨髓性白血病，預後不良。 目前的療法主要是為了控制症狀、血栓和脾腫大，但在某些患者中，除了聚乙二醇化幹擾素α和JAK2抑制劑外，它們的疾病修飾作用有限。 使用免疫療法和選擇性抑制劑選擇性針對突變型CALR和JAK2 V617F的新興療法可能是骨髓增生性腫瘤患者治療的突破，有望實現持久的疾病修飾和潛在的克隆根除。

articles.title: Carbocisteine or Hypertonic Saline for Acute Respiratory Failure
articles.authors: Connolly B, Dickson N, Campbell C, Bradley JM, O'Neill B, Agus A, Barker M, Bewley JS, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Mucoactive agents are widely used in patients with acute respiratory failure despite limited evidence of their effectiveness or safety.
abstract.textZh: 儘管其有效性或安全性的證據有限，但粘液活性藥物廣泛用於急性呼吸衰竭患者。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a multicenter, open-label, randomized trial with a 2-by-2 factorial design that involved critically ill, mechanically ventilated participants 16 years of age or older with acute respiratory failure and difficult-to-clear secretions. All participants received usual care along with carbocisteine (750 mg three times daily enterally), 6% or 7% nebulized hypertonic saline (HTS) (4 ml four times daily), both interventions, or usual care alone for up to 28 days. The primary outcome was duration of mechanical ventilation (from randomization to first successful unassisted breathing). The primary comparisons were between any carbocisteine and no carbocisteine and between any HTS and no HTS, with each comparison comprising two treatment groups.
abstract.textZh: 我們進行了一項多中心、開放標籤、隨機試驗，採用2 × 2因子設計，涉及16歲或以上患有急性呼吸衰竭和難以清除分泌物的重症患者、機械通氣的參與者。所有參與者均接受卡波西汀（ 750毫克，每日三次，腸道）、6%或7%霧化高滲鹽水（ HTS ） （ 4毫升，每日四次）、兩種幹預措施，或單獨接受常規護理長達28天。主要結果是機械通氣持續時間（從隨機分組到首次成功的無輔助呼吸）。主要比較為任何卡波西汀與無卡波西汀之間以及任何HTS與無HTS之間，每個比較包括兩個治療組。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 1956 participants underwent randomization: 486 were assigned to carbocisteine, 485 to HTS, 492 to both treatments, and 493 to usual care alone (472, 474, 479, and 478, respectively, were included in the primary analysis). No evidence of treatment interaction was found (hazard ratio, 1.01, 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.83 to 1.22; P = 0.91). The median duration of mechanical ventilation was 186.1 hours (95% CI, 168.3 to 196.6) with carbocisteine and 172.7 hours (95% CI, 165.2 to 190.4) with no carbocisteine (adjusted hazard ratio, 0.96; 95% CI, 0.87 to 1.05; P = 0.34) and 184.5 hours (95% CI, 165.6 to 194.1) with HTS and 174.3 hours (95% CI, 166.9 to 192.7) with no HTS (adjusted hazard ratio, 1.00; 95% CI, 0.91 to 1.10; P = 0.98). Clinically important upper gastrointestinal bleeding occurred significantly more often with carbocisteine than with no carbocisteine (13 of 965 [1.4%] vs. 2 of 966 [0.2%]; risk ratio, 6.51; 95% CI, 1.47 to 28.76; P = 0.01). Bronchoconstriction leading to bronchodilator use occurred significantly more often with HTS than with no HTS (23 of 967 [2.4%] vs. 4 of 964 [0.4%]; risk ratio, 5.73; 95% CI, 1.99 to 16.52; P = 0.001), as did hypoxemia during nebulization (40 of 967 [4.1%] vs. 3 of 964 [0.3%]; risk ratio, 13.29; 95% CI, 4.12 to 42.83; P<0.001). One serious adverse reaction was reported in the combination group.
abstract.textZh: 總共有1956名參與者接受了隨機分組： 486人被分配到卡波西坦， 485人被分配到HTS ， 492人被分配到兩種治療， 493人被分配到單獨的常規治療（主要分析分別包括472、474、479和478人）。 未發現治療相互作用的證據（風險比， 1.01 ， 95%置信區間[CI] ， 0.83至1.22 ； P = 0.91 ）。 使用卡波西汀的機械通氣持續時間中位數為186.1小時（ 95% CI ， 168.3至196.6 ） ，不使用卡波西汀的機械通氣持續時間中位數為172.7小時（ 95% CI ， 165.2至190.4 ） （調整風險比， 0.96 ； 95% CI ， 0.87至1.05 ； P = 0.34 ） ，使用HTS的機械通氣持續時間中位數為184.5小時（ 95% CI ， 165.6至194.1 ） ，不使用HTS的機械通氣持續時間中位數為174.3小時（ 95% CI ， 166.9至192.7 ） （調整風險比， 1.00 ； 95% CI ， 0.91至1.10 ； P = 0.98 ）。 臨牀上重要的上消化道出血發生率明顯高於不含碳水化合物的（ 13/965 [1.4%]對2/966 [0.2%] ；風險比為6.51 ； 95% CI為1.47至28.76 ； P = 0.01 ）。 導致使用支氣管擴張劑的支氣管收縮發生率明顯高於未使用支氣管擴張劑（ 967中有23例[2.4%] ， 964中有4例[0.4%] ；風險比為5.73 ； 95% CI為1.99至16.52 ； P = 0.001 ） ，霧化過程中的低氧血症也是如此（ 967中有40例[4.1%] ， 964中有3例[0.3%] ；風險比為13.29 ； 95% CI為4.12至42.83 ； P < 0.001 ）。 合併組報告了1例嚴重不良反應。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among critically ill patients with acute respiratory failure, neither carbocisteine nor HTS significantly reduced the duration of mechanical ventilation, and each was associated with harm. (Funded by the NIHR Health Technology Assessment Programme and the Belfast Health and Social Care Trust Charitable Trust Fund; MARCH ISRCTN Registry number, ISRCTN17683568.).

articles.title: Survodutide Once Weekly for the Treatment of Adults with Obesity
articles.authors: le Roux CW, Wharton S, Startseva E, Kloer IM, Hussain SA, Unseld A, Bozkurt B, Ard JD, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Although medications with glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist activity have transformed the management of obesity and shown substantial cardiometabolic benefits, unmet needs remain. Survodutide, an investigational glucagon receptor-GLP-1 receptor dual agonist, led to substantial weight reduction in a phase 2 trial involving adults with obesity without diabetes.
abstract.textZh: 雖然具有胰高血糖素樣肽-1 （ GLP-1 ）受體激動劑活性的藥物已經改變了肥胖的管理並顯示出顯著的心臟代謝益處，但未滿足的需求仍然存在。Survodutide是一種研究性胰高血糖素受體-GLP-1受體雙重激動劑，在一項涉及沒有糖尿病的肥胖成人的2期試驗中導致體重顯著減輕。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this phase 3, double-blind trial, we randomly assigned adults with a body-mass index (BMI; the weight in kilograms divided by the square of the height in meters) of 30 or higher, or 27 or higher with at least one obesity-related complication (excluding diabetes), in a 1:1:1 ratio to receive once-weekly survodutide administered subcutaneously at a dose adjusted up to 3.6 mg or 6.0 mg or placebo, in addition to counseling for lifestyle modification. The two primary end points were the percent change in body weight and a reduction in body weight of at least 5% from baseline to week 76. The primary efficacy analysis was conducted according to the treatment-regimen estimand, which incorporates the effects of any early discontinuation of survodutide or placebo, the use of protocol-prohibited obesity medications, and a prolonged dose-escalation period.
abstract.textZh: 在這項3期雙盲試驗中，我們以1: 1: 1的比例隨機分配體重指數（ BMI ；體重以公斤除以身高平方米為單位）為30或更高，或27或更高且至少有一種肥胖相關併發症（不包括糖尿病）的成年人接受每週一次的皮下給藥，劑量調整至3.6毫克或6.0毫克或安慰劑，以及生活方式調整的諮詢。兩個主要終點是從基線到第76週的體重變化百分比和體重減少至少5%。主要療效分析是根據治療方案預估值進行的，其中包括任何早期停用survodutide或安慰劑、使用計畫書禁止的肥胖藥物以及劑量遞增期延長的影響。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 725 participants (241 in the 3.6-mg survodutide group, 242 in the 6.0-mg survodutide group, and 242 in the placebo group), the mean age was 47.1 years; 294 participants (40.6%) were men. At baseline, the mean BMI was 37.9, and the mean body weight was 108.8 kg. At week 76, the mean change in body weight from baseline according to the treatment-regimen estimand was -12.2% (95% confidence interval [CI], -13.6 to -10.8) in the 3.6-mg group, -13.0% (95% CI, -14.4 to -11.6) in the 6.0-mg group, and -5.4% (95% CI, -6.9 to -4.0) in the placebo group; 72.6%, 71.9% and 46.3% of the participants, respectively, had weight reduction of at least 5% (P<0.001 for all comparisons with placebo). The most common adverse events were gastrointestinal symptoms (typically mild to moderate), which occurred in 80.9% of the participants in the 3.6-mg group, in 89.7% of those in the 6.0-mg group, and in 47.9% of those in the placebo group. No deaths were reported.

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Survodutide led to significantly greater reductions in body weight than placebo in adults with obesity without diabetes. (Funded by Boehringer Ingelheim; SYNCHRONIZE-1 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06066515.).

articles.title: First-Line Sunvozertinib in NSCLC with EGFR Exon 20 Insertion Mutations
articles.authors: Zhou C, Greillier L, Liu G, John T, Xing L, Kowalski D, Memmott RM, Yazici O, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Sunvozertinib received accelerated approval for use in later lines of therapy for patients with advanced non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) exon 20 insertion mutations. Data are needed on the efficacy and safety of sunvozertinib as a first-line treatment for NSCLC.
abstract.textZh: Sunvozertinib獲得加速批準，用於晚期非小細胞肺癌（ NSCLC ）伴表皮生長因子受體（ EGFR ）外顯子20插入突變的患者。需要關於sunvozertinib作為NSCLC一線治療藥物的有效性和安全性的數據。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this phase 3, international trial, we randomly assigned, in a 1:1 ratio, patients with advanced nonsquamous NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertions to receive sunvozertinib or chemotherapy (carboplatin-pemetrexed). The primary end point was progression-free survival as assessed by blinded independent central review. Crossover to the sunvozertinib group was allowed after disease progression was confirmed. Secondary end points included overall survival, investigator-assessed progression-free survival, objective response (complete or partial response), change in tumor size, and duration of response.
abstract.textZh: 在這項3期國際試驗中，我們以1: 1的比例，隨機將具有EGFR外顯子20插入的晚期非鱗狀NSCLC患者分配接受sunvozertinib或化療(carboplatin-pemetrexed)。主要終點是無惡化生存期，通過盲法獨立中心審查進行評估。確認疾病進展後，允許與sunvozertinib組交叉。次要終點包括總生存期、研究者評估的無惡化生存期、客觀反應（完全或部分反應）、腫瘤大小的變化和反應持續時間。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 324 patients were randomly assigned to receive sunvozertinib (163 patients) or chemotherapy (161 patients). Treatment with sunvozertinib led to significantly longer median progression-free survival than chemotherapy (10.3 vs. 7.5 months; hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.65; 95% confidence interval, 0.50 to 0.85; P<0.001). At 12 months, progression-free survival was reported in 46.1% of the patients in the sunvozertinib group and in 26.7% of those in the chemotherapy group; the data for overall survival were immature (38.9% maturity). The percentage of patients with an objective response was 58.9% in the sunvozertinib group and 31.1% in the chemotherapy group; the median best percentage change in tumor size was -42.1% and -24.7% respectively, and the median duration of response was 11.2 and 7.1 months. Grade 3 or higher adverse events were reported in 75.5% of the patients in the sunvozertinib group and in 56.7% of those in the chemotherapy group. In the sunvozertinib group, the most common adverse events of grade 3 or higher included increased serum creatine kinase levels, diarrhea, and anemia. No deaths were attributed to adverse events considered by the investigators to be related to sunvozertinib.
abstract.textZh: 共有324名患者被隨機分配接受sunvozertinib （ 163名患者）或化療（ 161名患者）。 Sunvozertinib治療導致中位無惡化生存期明顯長於化療（ 10.3個月對比7.5個月；疾病惡化或死亡風險比為0.65 ； 95%置信區間為0.50至0.85 ； P < 0.001 ）。 在12個月時， sunvozertinib組中46.1%的患者和化療組中26.7%的患者報告了無惡化生存期；整體生存期數據不成熟（ 38.9%成熟）。 客觀反應的患者百分比在sunvozertinib組中為58.9% ，在化療組中為31.1% ；腫瘤大小的最佳百分比變化中位數分別為-42.1%和-24.7% ，反應持續時間中位數為11.2個月和7.1個月。 Sunvozertinib組中75.5%的患者和化療組中56.7%的患者報告了3級或更高的不良事件。 在sunvozertinib組中， 3級或以上最常見的不良事件包括血清肌酸激酶濃度升高、腹瀉和貧血。 研究者認為與sunvozertinib有關的不良事件沒有導致死亡。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: The efficacy of sunvozertinib was superior to that of chemotherapy as first-line treatment for advanced NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertions. (Funded by Dizal Pharmaceuticals; WU-KONG28 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05668988.).
abstract.textZh: 對於插入EGFR外顯子20的晚期NSCLC ， sunvozertinib作為一線治療的療效優於化療。（由Dizal Pharmaceuticals資助； WU-KONG28 ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT05668988。）。

articles.titleZh: 具有EGFR外顯子20插入突變的NSCLC中的一線Sunvozertinib

articles.title: Azithromycin for Preschoolers with Wheezing in the Emergency Department
articles.authors: Denninghoff KR, Casper TC, Zorc JJ, Ruddy RM, Satola S, Wendt WJ, Morris CR, Tavarez MM, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Wheezing illnesses are a leading cause of hospitalization for preschool-age children and are frequently treated with antibiotics. Observational studies have shown more frequent isolation of three pathogenic bacteria (Streptococcus pneumoniae, Moraxella catarrhalis, and Haemophilus influenzae) from nasopharyngeal samples from children with recurrent episodes of wheezing than from those without such illnesses.
abstract.textZh: 喘鳴病是學齡前兒童住院的主要原因，並經常使用抗生素治療。觀察研究表明，從患有復發性喘息的兒童的鼻咽樣本中分離出三種致病細菌（肺炎鏈球菌、卡他莫拉氏菌和流感嗜血桿菌）的頻率高於從沒有這種疾病的兒童中分離出三種致病細菌。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this multicenter trial, we randomly assigned patients 18 to 59 months of age who presented to an emergency department with a moderate-to-severe episode of wheezing to receive azithromycin once daily at a dose of 12 mg per kilogram of body weight or matching placebo for 5 days. The primary outcome was the sum of scores on the Asthma Flare-up Diary for Young Children (ADYC) over 5 days. Primary-outcome scores could range from 5 to 35, with higher scores indicating more severe wheezing-related symptoms. Efficacy was assessed separately in patients who tested positive for pathogenic bacteria (the positive cohort) and in those who tested negative (the negative cohort). Secondary outcomes were length of stay in the emergency department, length of hospital stay, and return emergency department visits or hospitalizations within 72 hours. Bacterial clearance and antimicrobial resistance were measured at follow-up visits 1 to 3 weeks after randomization.
abstract.textZh: 在這項多中心試驗中，我們隨機分配了18至59個月的患者，他們在急診科出現中度至重度喘息發作，每天接受一次阿奇黴素，劑量為每公斤體重12毫克或相應的安慰劑，持續5天。主要結果是5天內幼兒哮喘發作日記（ ADYC ）的分數總和。主要結果分數可能在5到35之間，較高的分數表示更嚴重的喘鳴相關症狀。在病原菌檢測呈陽性的患者（陽性羣組）和檢測呈陰性的患者（陰性羣組）中分別評估有效性。次要結果是急診室的住院時間、住院時間，以及在72小時內返回急診室就診或住院。在隨機分組後1至3週的追蹤回診中測量細菌清除率和抗菌素耐藥性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 840 patients who underwent randomization, 521 tested positive for pathogenic bacteria. The trial was stopped for futility by the data and safety monitoring board after a planned interim analysis. ADYC scores did not differ significantly between the azithromycin and placebo groups in either the positive cohort (median, 9.59 [interquartile range, 7.29 to 12.60] vs. 9.72 [interquartile range, 7.66 to 12.17]; P = 0.70) or the negative cohort (median, 9.30 [interquartile range, 6.97 to 11.62] vs. 9.10 [interquartile range, 7.19 to 11.45]; P = 0.69). In the positive cohort, bacterial clearance was 58.7% in the azithromycin group and 11.4% in the placebo group. Secondary outcomes appeared to be similar in the two groups for both cohorts, as did the development of bacterial resistance and the incidence of adverse events.
abstract.textZh: 在接受隨機分組的840名患者中， 521名檢測出致病細菌陽性。在計劃的期中分析之後，數據和安全監測委員會因無效而停止試驗。阿奇黴素和安慰劑組之間的ADYC評分在陽性羣組（中位數， 9.59 [四分位數範圍， 7.29至12.60]對比9.72 [四分位數範圍， 7.66至12.17] ； P = 0.70 ）或陰性羣組（中位數， 9.30 [四分位數範圍， 6.97至11.62]對比9.10 [四分位數範圍， 7.19至11.45] ； P = 0.69 ）中均無顯著差異。在陽性羣組中，阿奇黴素組的細菌清除率為58.7% ，安慰劑組為11.4%。兩組的次要結果似乎相似，細菌耐藥性的發展和不良事件的發生率也是如此。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Azithromycin did not lead to a greater reduction in the severity of wheezing-related symptoms than placebo in preschool-age children who presented to the emergency department with moderate-to-severe acute wheezing. (Funded by the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute and others; AZ-SWED ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT04669288.).
abstract.textZh: 與安慰劑相比，阿奇黴素在急診科出現中度至重度急性喘息的學齡前兒童中並未導致喘息相關症狀的嚴重程度降低。（由國家心臟、肺和血液研究所及其他機構資助； AZ-SWED ClinicalTrials.gov編號為NCT04669288。）。

articles.title: Arginine Therapy for Sickle Cell Disease Acute Pain Episodes: The STArT Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Morris CR, Hatabah D, Korman R, Ahmad FA, Airewele G, Akinsola B, Alzraikat N, Bakshi N, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Acute pain episodes are the leading cause of emergency department visits and hospitalizations for patients with sickle cell disease (SCD), yet US Food and Drug Administration-approved drugs for acute pain episodes are lacking. During acute pain episodes, patients develop acute arginine deficiency associated with longer time to crisis resolution and greater total parenteral opioid use. Multiple single-center, phase 2 randomized clinical trials have shown that arginine is safe, is opioid sparing, improves cardiopulmonary function, and reduces length of hospital stay.
abstract.textZh: 急性疼痛發作是鐮狀細胞病（ SCD ）患者急診部門就診和住院的主要原因，但缺乏美國食品和藥物管理局批準的急性疼痛發作藥物。在急性疼痛發作期間，患者會出現急性精氨酸缺乏症，這與更長的危機解決時間和更多的非腸道阿片類藥物使用有關。多項單中心、2期隨機臨牀試驗表明，精氨酸是安全的，可以保留鴉片類藥物，改善心肺功能，並縮短住院時間。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To determine the efficacy and safety of intravenous arginine for SCD acute pain episodes.
abstract.textZh: 確定靜脈注射精氨酸治療SCD急性疼痛發作的有效性和安全性。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Prospective, phase 3, double-blind randomized clinical trial conducted between June 21, 2021, and June 13, 2024, in 10 US children's hospitals enrolling patients aged 3 to 21 years presenting to the emergency department with SCD acute pain episodes requiring parenteral opioids.
abstract.textZh: 2021年6月21日至2024年6月13日期間在10家美國兒童醫院進行的前瞻性3期雙盲隨機臨牀試驗，招募3至21歲的SCD急性疼痛發作需要腸外阿片類藥物的患者。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Patients were randomized to receive intravenous arginine (200 mg/kg followed by 100 mg/kg every 8 hours until discharge; n = 129) or saline placebo (n = 142).
abstract.textZh: 患者隨機接受靜脈注射精氨酸（ 200 mg/kg ，然後每8小時100 mg/kg ，直至出院； n = 129 ）或食鹽水安慰劑（ n = 142 ）。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary outcome was time to crisis resolution, defined as hours from initial study drug delivery to last intravenous opioid dose. Secondary outcomes included total parenteral opioid use (intravenous morphine equivalents in milligrams per kilogram from first study drug dose to last intravenous opioid dose), pain scores, and patient-reported outcomes.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是解決危機的時間，定義為從最初的研究藥物遞送到最後一次靜脈注射阿片類藥物劑量的小時。次要結果包括總腸外阿片類藥物使用（從第一次研究藥物劑量到最後一次靜脈內阿片類藥物劑量的靜脈內嗎啡當量每公斤毫克）、疼痛評分和患者報告的結果。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of 274 randomized participants, 271 received study drug; the mean age was 14.3 years (SD, 4.3 years), 51% were male, and 92% were Black. The trial was halted early for futility, as time to crisis resolution was similar in those receiving arginine vs placebo (median, 60.8 hours [IQR, 34.8-109.0 hours] vs 65.8 hours [IQR, 31.1-111.1 hours], respectively; absolute difference, 7.2 hours; 95% CI, -21.6 to 35.9 hours). No significant differences were seen in total parenteral opioid use, pain scores, patient-reported outcomes, or safety events.
abstract.textZh: 在274名隨機受試者中， 271人接受了研究藥物；平均年齡為14.3歲（ SD ， 4.3歲） ， 51%為男性， 92%為黑人。該試驗因無效而提前停止，因為接受精氨酸與安慰劑的受試者解決危機的時間相似（中位數，分別為60.8小時[IQR ， 34.8-109.0小時]與65.8小時[IQR ， 31.1-111.1小時] ；絕對差異為7.2小時； 95% CI ， -21.6至35.9小時）。在總腸外阿片類藥物使用、疼痛評分、患者報告的結果或安全性事件中未見顯著差異。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Arginine therapy did not shorten time to crisis resolution compared with placebo among children and young adults with SCD acute pain episodes.
abstract.textZh: 與安慰劑相比，在患有SCD急性疼痛發作的兒童和年輕成人中，精氨酸治療並沒有縮短解決危機的時間。

articles.title: Daily Zinc Supplementation for Infection Prevention in Children With Sickle Cell Anemia: The ZIPS-2 Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Namazzi R, Mellencamp KA, Bagala I, Conroy AL, Kato C, Birungi I, Kasembo P, Kyarisiima G, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Despite existing prevention strategies, infections remain a major cause of morbidity and mortality in children in Africa with sickle cell anemia.
abstract.textZh: 儘管有現有的預防策略，感染仍然是非洲鐮狀細胞貧血兒童發病和死亡的主要原因。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To determine the safety and effectiveness of daily zinc supplementation to prevent all-cause infection in children with sickle cell anemia in Uganda.
abstract.textZh: 確定每日補鋅的安全性和有效性，以預防烏幹達鐮狀細胞貧血兒童的全因感染。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of children aged 1.00 to 4.99 years with sickle cell anemia at Jinja Regional Referral Hospital in Jinja, Uganda, from February 10, 2025, to April 30, 2025, with 6 months of follow-up through November 7, 2025.
abstract.textZh: 2025年2月10日至2025年4月30日在烏幹達Jinja的Jinja區域轉診醫院進行的一項隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照試驗，對1.00至4.99歲患有鐮狀細胞性貧血的兒童進行6個月的隨訪，直至2025年11月7日。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Participants received zinc sulfate at 20 mg daily or placebo daily for 6 months.
abstract.textZh: 參與者每天接受20毫克硫酸鋅或安慰劑，持續6個月。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary outcome was all-cause infections per 100 person-years, using standardized clinical criteria to define infections.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是每100人-年的全因感染，使用標準化的臨牀標準來定義感染。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 118 children screened for eligibility, 100 were randomly assigned to receive zinc supplementation (n = 50) or placebo (n = 50) (mean [SD] age, 36.0 [13.2] months; 45 female [45%]). At enrollment, 45 participants (45%) were receiving hydroxyurea therapy. All participants initiated or continued receiving hydroxyurea after enrollment. During the 6-month follow-up, there was complete ascertainment for all participants and no loss to follow-up. There were 80 all-cause infections in the zinc group and 124 in the placebo group, corresponding to a significantly lower infection rate in the zinc group than the placebo group (305.7 [95% CI, 242.4-380.4] infections per 100 person-years vs 480.7 [95% CI, 399.8-573.1] infections per 100 person-years; rate difference, -176.0 [95% CI, -300.8 to -51.3]; incidence rate ratio after adjustment for baseline age, sex, and hydroxyurea use, 0.62 [95% CI, 0.45-0.86]). No adverse events requiring discontinuation of the study intervention were observed in either group.
abstract.textZh: 在篩選合格性的118名兒童中， 100名被隨機分配接受補鋅（ n = 50 ）或安慰劑（ n = 50 ） （平均[SD]年齡， 36.0 [13.2]個月； 45名女性[45%] ）。 在入組時， 45名參與者（ 45 ％ ）正在接受羥基脲治療。 所有參與者在入組後開始或繼續接受羥基脲。 在6個月的追蹤期間，所有參與者都得到了完全的確認，並且沒有失去追蹤。 鋅組有80例全因感染，安慰劑組有124例全因感染，相應於鋅組的感染率顯著低於安慰劑組（每100人-年的感染率為305.7 [95% CI ， 242.4-380.4] ，而每100人-年的感染率為480.7 [95% CI ， 399.8-573.1] ；感染率差異為-176.0 [95% CI ， -300.8至-51.3] ；基線年齡、性別和羥基脲使用調整後的發病率比率為0.62 [95% CI ， 0.45-0.86] ）。 兩組均未觀察到需要停止研究幹預的不良事件。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Zinc supplementation at 20 mg per day reduced all-cause infection in children with sickle cell anemia younger than 5 years in Uganda. Multisite clinical trials are needed to validate these findings and to assess effectiveness in older children.
abstract.textZh: 在烏幹達，每天補充20毫克鋅可減少5歲以下鐮狀細胞性貧血兒童的全因感染。需要多站點臨牀試驗來驗證這些發現並評估對年齡較大的兒童的有效性。

abstract.text: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT06561061.
abstract.textZh: ClinicalTrials.gov識別碼： NCT06561061。

articles.title: Longitudinal Changes in Heart Stress and the Risk for Cardiovascular Disease and Mortality in Older Adults : An Observational Study
articles.authors: Cai A, Bayes-Genis A, Wolfe R, Tonkin AM, Zhu C, Januzzi JL, Zheng J, Nelson MR, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Age-specific elevation in N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) concentrations, previously termed "heart stress (HS)," has been associated with adverse cardiovascular disease (CVD) outcomes. Yet, HS status, as defined by longitudinal changes in NT-proBNP concentrations, may improve risk assessment for CVD and mortality in older adults.
abstract.textZh: N末端B型前利鈉肽（ NT-proBNP ）濃度（以前稱為「心臟壓力（ HS ）」）的年齡特異性升高與不良心血管疾病（ CVD ）結果有關。然而，由NT-proBNP濃度的縱向變化定義的HS狀態可能會改善老年人心血管疾病和死亡率的風險評估。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate HS status on the basis of 3-year changes in NT-proBNP concentrations with risk for total CVD and all-cause mortality in community-dwelling older adults free of prior CVD.
abstract.textZh: 根據NT-proBNP濃度的3年變化評估HS狀態，該變化在沒有既往CVD的社區居住老年人中具有總CVD和全因死亡率的風險。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Observational study.
abstract.textZh: 觀察性研究。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: The ASPREE (ASPirin in Reducing Events in the Elderly) trial and subsequent observational extension (ASPREE-XT).
abstract.textZh: ASPREE （減少老年人事件的ASPirin ）試驗和隨後的觀察擴展（ ASPREE-XT ）。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: 8454 participants (mean age, 78.0 years at year 3; 52.9% women) without prior CVD who had NT-proBNP measured at trial enrollment and year 3.
abstract.textZh: 8454名參與者（平均年齡，第3年78.0歲； 52.9%婦女）在試驗入組和第3年進行NT-proBNP測量。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Heart stress status, based on changes in NT-proBNP concentrations from enrollment to year 3, was examined in 4 categories: persistently HS-free, HS remission, incident HS, or sustained HS. The 2 coprimary outcomes were total CVD (nonfatal myocardial infarction, fatal or nonfatal stroke, coronary heart disease death, or heart failure hospitalization) and all-cause mortality.
abstract.textZh: 基於NT-proBNP濃度從入組到第3年的變化，在4個類別中檢查了心臟應激狀態：持續無HS、HS緩解、事故HS或持續HS。2個共主要結果是總CVD （非致命性心肌梗死、致命性或非致命性中風、冠心病死亡或心力衰竭住院）和全因死亡率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Over a median follow-up of 8.0 years, 818 CVD events and 1584 deaths occurred. At year 8, compared with the persistently HS-free category, the adjusted absolute risks (ARs) for total CVD were increased by 7.4% (95% CI, 4.8% to 10.0%) for incident HS and 6.7% (CI, 4.3% to 9.0%) for sustained HS; adjusted ARs were also increased for all-cause mortality by 6.1% (CI, 3.7% to 8.5%) for incident HS and 7.5% (CI, 5.2% to 9.8%) for sustained HS. The HS remission category had similar adjusted ARs to those of the persistently HS-free group.

articles.title: Randomized Quality Improvement Trials: An Overview and Proposed Framework for Ethical Oversight
articles.authors: Pletcher MJ, Lo B, Grady D

abstract.text: Quality improvement (QI) is a routine part of health care delivery, but ineffective QI can have unintended consequences, waste resources, and paradoxically worsen health care quality. Randomized QI (RQI) trials use randomization to assign the QI intervention to some but not all patients or clinicians. An RQI trial can provide strong evidence to health care leaders making decisions about whether to scale up, modify, or abandon a QI intervention, but such trials are infrequently used due primarily to a lack of clarity about how regulations and ethical principles apply to these studies. We propose a definition for RQI trials and a streamlined, fit-for-purpose approach to ethical oversight that is consistent with federal regulations. Conducting RQI trials requires careful ethical justification as informed consent is generally impracticable. For this reason, we argue that ethical oversight is needed, even if the project does not qualify as research, and that regular monitoring should be conducted to help decide when the trial should end. Installing technical systems and processes for internal registration, point-of-care randomization, and standardized statistical analyses will help health systems use RQI trials routinely to learn what works to improve the quality of care they deliver for patients.

abstract.textZh: 在2015年至2023年期間，有11,776名年輕人首次登記在學習障礙登記冊上。2020-2021年，不同年齡和性別的新註冊率有所增加，在2023年之前恢復到2019年之前的水平之前， 14-17歲男性的新註冊率高達每10 000 PYAR 15.8 ，女性為每10 000 PYAR 8.4。記錄的總體患病率仍然很低（ 0.03-0.5 ％ ；每萬人3.6-52.7 ） ，但在18-24歲的人羣中增加， 2015年至2023年間增加了8至10倍。男性的患病率較高（比率比為1.7-1.8 ， 95%置信區間= 1.6-1.9 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: National targets coincided with a temporary rise in enrolment, but identification remains below expected prevalence. Sustained policy focus and systematic identification and coding by practices are needed to ensure equitable access to preventive care during the transition to adulthood.
abstract.textZh: 國家目標與入學率暫時上升相吻合，但識別率仍低於預期流行率。需要持續的政策重點以及按實踐進行系統識別和編碼，以確保在向成年過渡期間公平獲得預防性護理。

articles.title: Disparities in the uptake of learning disability annual health checks: a secondary analysis of primary care data
articles.authors: Sutherland D, Costello B, Chauhan U, Flynn S, Gray KM, Parsons J, Spencer R, Crawford H

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: People with intellectual disabilities (referred to as learning disabilities in the UK) face considerable health inequalities. One attempt to address these in England has been through incentivising general practices to complete annual health checks with people with a learning disability aged ≥14 years.
abstract.textZh: 智障人士（英國稱為學習障礙）面臨相當大的健康不平等。在英格蘭，解決這些問題的一個嘗試是通過激勵一般做法，對年齡大於或等於14歲的學習障礙者完成年度健康檢查。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To examine recent trends in learning disability registers and the uptake of learning disability annual health checks in England.
abstract.textZh: 檢查英格蘭學習障礙登記的近期趨勢和學習障礙年度健康檢查的採用情況。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Secondary analysis of publicly available general practice data.
abstract.textZh: 公開一般實踐資料的次要分析。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: NHS England data relating to the learning disabilities annual health check scheme from January 2022 to November 2025 were compiled and analysed.
abstract.textZh: 我們彙編並分析了英國國民保健署（ NHS ）在2022年1月至2025年11月期間與學習障礙年度健康檢查計劃相關的數據。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The number of 14-17-year-olds and adults on learning disability registers increased during this period by 30.49% and 14.53%, respectively. The most recent estimates indicate that around 0.588% (n = 374 763/63 766 671) of patients are on learning disability registers, with approximately 0.526% (n = 355 102/63 654 156) aged ≥14 years and eligible for annual health checks. The uptake of annual health checks increased slightly from 68.08% (n = 15 940/23 414) to 71.58% (n = 19 217/26 846) among 14-17-year-olds, and from 79.07% (n = 226 701/286 714) to 80.71% (n = 248 449/307 827) among adults. Uptake was lowest in the South West and East of England, and highest in London, but was similar across deciles of patient deprivation and practice size.
abstract.textZh: 在此期間，學習障礙登記冊上的14-17歲和成人人數分別增加了30.49%和14.53%。最近的估計表明，約有0.588 ％ （ n = 374 763/63 766 671 ）的患者在學習障礙登記冊上，約有0.526 ％ （ n = 355 102/63 654 156 ）年齡≥ 14歲，有資格進行年度健康檢查。14-17歲兒童接受年度健康檢查的比例從68.08% （ n = 15 940/23 414 ）略微增加到71.58% （ n = 19 217/26 846 ） ，成年人從79.07% （ n = 226 701/286 714 ）增加到80.71% （ n = 248 449/307 827 ）。攝取量在英格蘭西南部和東部最低，在倫敦最高，但在患者剝奪和實踐規模方面相似。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Ascertainment of people with a learning disability by primary care services appears to be improving but remains between one-third and one-quarter of prevalence estimates. The uptake of annual health checks among 14-17-year-olds continues to lag behind that of adults.
abstract.textZh: 初級護理服務對學習障礙人士的確定似乎正在改善，但仍在估計患病率的三分之一至四分之一之間。14-17歲的年度健康檢查率繼續落後於成年人。

articles.title: Investigating the conditions in which women GPs thrive in general practice: a realist review
articles.authors: Abrams R, Williams V, Park S, Golder S, Goyal A, Whiley L, Jefferson L

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Women GPs experience higher rates of burnout, anxiety, depression, and slower career progression than men GPs. Women GPs are sought out by patients for specific conditions, which may increase consultation length. This can be a source of job satisfaction for some. However, it can also contribute to additional exhaustion and affects career progression, meaning women GPs are at higher risk of leaving the profession. There is an urgent need to identify solutions to retain and support them.
abstract.textZh: 與男性全科醫生相比，女性全科醫生的職業倦怠、焦慮、抑鬱和職業發展緩慢率更高。患者會針對特定情況尋求女性全科醫生，這可能會增加會診時間。對某些人來說，這可能是工作滿意度的來源。然而，它也可能導致額外的疲憊並影響職業發展，這意味著女性全科醫生離開職業的風險更高。迫切需要確定留住和支持他們的解決方案。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: This review brings together a wide range of evidence to identify the conditions in which women GPs can thrive, to better support them at work.
abstract.textZh: 這項審查匯集了廣泛的證據，以確定女性全科醫生可以茁壯成長的條件，以便在工作中更好地支持她們。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: An international realist review of academic and grey literature was conducted across eight databases and Google Scholar.
abstract.textZh: 在八個資料庫和Google學術搜尋中，對學術文獻和灰色文獻進行了國際現實主義審查。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Following a realist approach, supported by stakeholder and patient involvement, a range of published documents were analysed using a realist logic to identify how, why, for whom, and in what circumstances women GPs thrive at work.
abstract.textZh: 在利益相關者和患者參與的支持下，遵循現實主義的方法，使用現實主義邏輯分析了一系列已發佈的文件，以確定女性全科醫生如何、為什麼、為誰以及在什麼情況下在工作中茁壯成長。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 72 documents are included in this review. Sixteen configurations describe the conditions in which women GPs can thrive. Results cover the following three concepts: patient-facing work; navigating competing roles; and sustainable careers, leadership, and success. However, literature also places heavy reliance on encouraging women GPs to 'fix' their own circumstances.
abstract.textZh: 本次審核共包含72份文件。十六種配置描述了女性全科醫生可以茁壯成長的條件。結果涵蓋以下三個概念：面向患者的工作；導航相互競爭的角色；以及可持續的職業生涯、領導力和成功。然而，文獻也嚴重依賴鼓勵女性全科醫生「修復」自己的情況。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: This review provides evidence-based recommendations that may be of interest to those responsible for organisational culture within general practices, including (but not limited to) GP partners, and women GPs, who can utilise the recommendations to influence change.
abstract.textZh: 本審查提供以證據為基礎的建議，這些建議可能對一般實踐中負責組織文化的人員感興趣，包括（但不限於）全科醫生合作夥伴和女性全科醫生，他們可以利用這些建議來影響變革。

articles.titleZh: 調查女性全科醫生在一般診所中茁壯成長的條件：現實主義審查

articles.title: Association of the NHS Health Check with all-cause mortality: a longitudinal cohort study in primary care
articles.authors: Saund J, Dodhia H, Vanoli J, Masselot P, O'Neill S

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) prevention is a policy priority because of widening inequalities and increasing preventable deaths. The NHS Health Check (NHS-HC) programme aims to promote early detection and prevention of CVD but has a wider-reaching impact owing to targeting multiple risk factors. Although programme evaluations demonstrate improvements in detection and surrogate markers, research on mortality outcomes remain limited, particularly using representative, real-world data.
abstract.textZh: 由於不平等擴大和可預防的死亡人數增加，心血管疾病（ CVD ）預防是政策優先事項。NHS健康檢查（ NHS-HC ）計劃旨在促進CVD的早期發現和預防，但由於針對多種風險因素，具有更廣泛的影響。儘管計劃評估顯示檢測和替代標記有所改善，但對死亡率結果的研究仍然有限，特別是使用具有代表性的真實世界數據。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To evaluate the effectiveness of NHS-HCs in reducing all-cause mortality.
abstract.textZh: 評估NHS-HCs在降低全因死亡率方面的有效性。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Longitudinal cohort study in an inner-city London borough.
abstract.textZh: 倫敦內城區的縱向隊列研究。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Data from electronic primary care records were analysed for 158 645 eligible participants (2009-2023). Survival was modelled using a Cox proportional hazards model with time-varying exposure. All-cause mortality risk was compared between those attending ≥1 NHS-HC (n = 42 589) and those who did not (n = 116 056). Sociodemographic, geographic, and behavioural factors were adjusted using propensity score weighting.
abstract.textZh: 對158,645名合格參與者（ 2009-2023年）的電子初級護理記錄數據進行了分析。使用具有時變暴露的Cox比例風險模型對存活率進行建模。參加≥ 1 NHS-HC的患者（ n = 42 589 ）和未參加NHS-HC的患者（ n = 116 056 ）之間的全因死亡率風險進行了比較。使用傾向分數加權調整社會人口、地理和行為因素。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of the 158 645 participants, 63 347 (39.9%) were of Black, Asian, mixed, or other ethnicity, and 100 825 (63.6%) lived in the two most deprived quintiles in England. Attendance at ≥1 NHS-HC was associated with lower mortality (adjusted hazard ratio 0.68, 95% confidence interval = 0.63 to 0.74), indicating a 32% reduction in risk. Ten-year absolute mortality risk reduction increased with age, with the largest difference among those aged 70-74 years (18.1% versus 12.9%). Sensitivity analyses supported these findings.
abstract.textZh: 在158 645名參與者中， 63 347人（ 39.9% ）為黑人、亞裔、混血或其他種族， 100 825人（ 63.6% ）居住在英格蘭最貧困的兩個五分之一人口中。≥ 1 NHS-HC的出勤率與較低的死亡率有關（調整後的風險比為0.68 ， 95%置信區間= 0.63至0.74 ） ，表明風險降低了32%。10年絕對死亡率風險降低隨著年齡的增長而增加，其中70-74歲之間的差異最大（ 18.1 ％對12.9 ％ ）。敏感性分析支持這些發現。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: This study suggests significant long-term survival benefit associated with the NHS-HC, supporting continued investment in and optimisation of the programme to provide population health benefits. Findings were robust to missing data assumptions and COVID-19, although residual confounding cannot be ruled out.
abstract.textZh: 這項研究表明，與NHS-HC相關的顯著長期生存益處，支持對該計劃的持續投資和優化，以提供人羣健康益處。雖然不能排除遺漏數據假設和COVID-19的殘留混淆，但調查結果對於遺漏數據假設和COVID-19來說是強有力的。

articles.title: General practice closures or mergers: a survival analysis of contributing practice
articles.authors: Hutchinson J, Anderson M, Santos R, Kontopantelis E, Sutton M

abstract.text: Background 20% of general practices in the England have closed or merged since 2013. Little is known about factors that are associated with these closures, despite evidence on their negative impacts. Understanding these risks is important for recovering general practice. Aim Describe how differences in the patient mix, practice location, workforce, funding and quality are associated with the future risk of closure Design and Setting Multilevel survival analysis of all general practices in England. Method All practices open on 1st April 2019 were followed until 1st April 2025 or closure. We gathered data on practice population characteristics, workforce, funding and quality. Cox proportional hazards models were used to analyse how these measures were associated with time to closure. Results Practice contract type and geographic location (region and rurality) were key factors associated with closures or mergers. For example, rates ranged from 3.7% to 19.7% by geographic region. Greater risk was associated with smaller practices, with a practice at the 10th percentile (3,032 patients) having 253% (95% CrI: 200%, 312%) higher risk of closure or merger than the median (7,256 patients). Greater risk of closure or merger was associated with losing or failing to gain patients (hazard ratio v medium increase 1.68 (95%CrI: 1.44, 1.96), lower baseline funding, poorer clinical quality, higher socioeconomic deprivation and certain contract types, but not the supply of general practitioners or nurses. Conclusion The practice contract, relevant region, practice list size, funding and quality are key hazards for the subsequent closure or merger of general practices.

articles.title: Talking about online activity and mental health with young people in primary care: A qualitative interview study
articles.authors: Archer C, Linton MJ, Kessler D, Wiles N, Biddle L

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Young people - aged 16-24 - are high users of digital technology. Online activity can be both beneficial for mental health and harmful. Appointments in general practice (GP) or primary care talking therapy provide opportunities to discuss online activity and its impact on mental health with young people. Such conversations could have preventive value by increasing awareness of problematic behaviours, identifying risk and suggest safer use strategies. However, little is known about whether such conversations are currently delivered in primary care.
abstract.textZh: 年輕人（ 16-24歲）是數位技術的高使用者。線上活動既有益於心理健康，也有害於心理健康。一般診所（ GP ）或初級護理談話治療的預約提供了與年輕人討論線上活動及其對心理健康影響的機會。這樣的對話可以通過提高對問題行為的認識、識別風險和建議更安全的使用策略來具有預防價值。然而，目前對初級保健中是否提供此類對話知之甚少。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore practitioners views on discussing online activity and its role in the mental health of young people in primary care.
abstract.textZh: 探索從業人員對討論線上活動及其在初級保健年輕人心理健康中的作用的看法。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Qualitative study with practitioners in GP and Talking Therapy Method: Semi-structured interviews with 24 practitioners, analysed using reflexive thematic analysis.
abstract.textZh: 與GP和談話治療方法的從業人員進行定性研究：與24名從業人員進行半結構化訪談，使用反射性主題分析進行分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Practitioners recognise helpful and harmful aspects to online activity, but there is variation in whether practitioners currently ask about online activity and whether they consider conversations appropriate for primary care. Several factors may shape confidence and decision making: practitioners own understanding of the online world; unable to change the impact on mental health or signpost to services; limitations in time, confidence or topic awareness. Practitioners identified a need for guidance and training to inform conversations about online activity.
abstract.textZh: 從業人員認識到線上活動的有益和有害方面，但從業人員目前是否詢問線上活動以及他們是否認為對話適合初級保健存在差異。有幾個因素可能會影響信心和決策：從業者自己對網絡世界的理解；無法改變對心理健康的影響或服務的路標；時間、信心或主題意識的限制。從業人員認為有必要提供指導和培訓，以告知有關線上活動的對話。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: There is variation in whether conversations about online activity with young people are happening in primary care. The development of best-practice resources is required to ensure conversations are acceptable to young people and effective at changing problematic online activity to improve mental health.

articles.title: Why Primary Care Clinicians use Advice and Guidance: A qualitative study
articles.authors: Faux-Nightingale A, Harrison R, Burton C, Bajpai R, Clarson L, Hadley-Barrows T, Haines J, Helliwell T, et al.

abstract.text: Background Where available, Advice and Guidance (A&G) can enable primary care clinicians to seek specialist input, supporting decision making and avoiding unnecessary referrals. The use of A&G has significantly expanded, accelerated by COVID19 and contractual changes. While A&G is intended to streamline elective care, concerns persist regarding workload shift, variable responsiveness, and system usability. Despite growing policy emphasis, little is known about why clinicians choose to use A&G. Aim Explore the current use of A&G within primary care, focusing on decision making processes which underpin PCCs' (primary care clinicians') decision to use A&G. Design and Setting Qualitative study set in English Primary Care Method Twenty semi structured video interviews were conducted with primary care clinicians purposively sampled for maximum variation. Data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis within an interpretive description framework, with themes developed collaboratively and refined through discussion with researchers and PPIE contributors. Ethical approval was obtained (REC 333799). Results Four overarching themes encapsulate clinicians' decisions to use A&G: clinical presentation (acuity and complexity), navigating healthcare pathways, previous experiences of A&G, and using A&G to validate clinical decision making. Barriers included delayed responses and uncertainty about inequitable workload distribution. These factors shape how effectively A&G could be integrated into routine practice. Conclusion Primary care clinicians use A&G to support patient care and aid decision-making, but its effectiveness depends on timely, clinically helpful responses. Ensuring responses remain appropriate to primary care remit and capacity will be essential if A&G becomes the main route into elective care.

articles.title: Public Policy Approaches to Addressing Adult Obesity: A Position Paper From the American College of Physicians
articles.authors: Crowley R, Beachy M, Carr P, Health and Public Policy Committee of the American College of Physicians

abstract.text: Forty percent of U.S. adults have obesity, a complex condition determined by genetics, behavior, environment, and other modifiable and nonmodifiable factors. Obesity is associated with certain comorbid conditions, including type 2 diabetes, high cholesterol, heart disease, and some cancer types, and may increase the severity of communicable illnesses, such as influenza. Treatments of obesity include behavioral modification, pharmacotherapy, and surgical procedures, but high cost and coverage restrictions are a substantial barrier for many patients. In this position paper, the American College of Physicians (ACP) offers recommendations on how policymakers can increase the affordability and accessibility of obesity treatment for adults and address modifiable factors that contribute to obesity, like diet and physical activity. ACP also includes recommendations on reducing stigma associated with obesity, improving understanding of obesity among physicians, increasing access to healthy food, and curbing the proliferation of unhealthy, highly processed fare. Population health strategies for addressing obesity are also discussed.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: In 2025, the United States experienced its highest measles case count since 1992. In New Mexico, 100 confirmed measles cases (99 outbreak-related cases), including 1 death, occurred across 9 counties from February through September 2025.

abstract.text: To estimate the societal economic burden of this outbreak while highlighting public health expenditures for vaccination-related activities that supported outbreak control and prevention of future outbreaks.

articles.title: Comprehensiveness Revisited for Next-Generation Family Medicine
articles.authors: Bazemore A, Krist A, Katz A

abstract.text: Comprehensiveness has long been a defining principle of family medicine (FM), and a reason that primary care delivers better outcomes at lower cost with greater equity. Yet rising patient complexity, narrower scopes of practice, workforce strain, and misaligned payment and credentialing systems have made sustaining traditional "full-basket" care increasingly difficult. In 2025, the Family Medicine Leadership Consortium convened a national dialogue to examine whether and how the discipline should reaffirm comprehensiveness as its core organizing principle. Participants agreed it remains essential to family medicine's identity and public value but emphasized the need to redefine it for modern realities, balancing breadth and depth of care, recognizing limits on individual physicians, and shifting accountability toward interprofessional teams and broader care ecosystems. The envisioned next-generation model situates comprehensiveness across the clinician, team, practice, and community levels, supported by longitudinal relationships, team-based care, and enabling technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI). This reconceptualization offers a framework for training, workforce strategy, measurement, and payment that preserves family medicine's generalist identity while advancing access, quality, equity, and sustainability.
abstract.textZh: 長期以來，全面性一直是家庭醫學（ FM ）的定義原則，也是初級保健以更低的成本提供更好的結果並且更公平的原因。 然而，不斷增加的患者複雜性、狹窄的實踐範圍、勞動力壓力以及錯誤的支付和認證系統，使得維持傳統的「全籃子」護理變得越來越困難。 2025年，家庭醫學領導聯盟召開了全國對話，研究該學科是否以及如何重申全面性作為其核心組織原則。 參與者一致認為，家庭醫學對於家庭醫學的身份和公共價值至關重要，但強調有必要根據現代現實重新定義家庭醫學，平衡護理的廣度和深度，認識到個別醫生的局限性，並將責任轉向跨專業團隊和更廣泛的護理生態系統。 所設想的下一代模式將臨牀醫生、團隊、實踐和社區層面的全面性置於縱向關係、基於團隊的護理和人工智能（ AI ）等使能技術的支持下。 這種重新概念化為培訓、勞動力戰略、衡量和支付提供了一個框架，在促進可及性、質量、公平性和可持續性的同時，保留了家庭醫學的通才身份。

articles.authors: Price DW, Cole SZ, Misra S

abstract.text: In August 2025, leaders from family medicine organizations and representative patient stakeholders met for discussions regarding the evolution of the clinical model for family medicine. Performance improvement (PI), long a part of the continuing board certification process, was among the topics discussed. Pockets of concern or confusion remain about the relevance, importance, practicality, and administrative burden of PI for practicing family physicians. This discussion paper summarizes concerns about PI as commonly currently operationalized and outlines the rationale for inclusion of PI in the clinical model of family medicine. It outlines opportunities for the progression of PI to become less single-disease metric focused to practically focus on team-based care, complexity, and patient-centered outcomes, while accounting for the variety of contexts in which family physicians practice.

abstract.text: Family physicians should be providing care for hospitalized patients. This fulfills part of our mission and opens opportunities for us to improve patient care and metrics, advance in leadership, teach residents and medical students, and influence and do research; caring for hospitalized patients also brings value to the patients, the system, and family physicians generally. articles.title: Demographic Disparities Among Emerging Adults Experiencing Loneliness
articles.authors: Keiser B, Cortez K, Hsu C, Stephens KA, Tong ST

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Loneliness has increased in recent years and is associated with poorer physical and mental health outcomes. While much research has focused on older adults, to date there has been limited research into loneliness in young adults who have the highest rates of loneliness. This study explores loneliness rates among subgroups of emerging adults ages 18-25.
abstract.textZh: 近年來，孤獨感有所增加，與身心健康狀況不佳有關。雖然許多研究都集中在老年人身上，但迄今為止，對孤獨率最高的年輕人的孤獨感的研究有限。本研究探討18-25歲新興成人次組的孤獨率。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: A cross-sectional survey was conducted in a large primary-care health system in Washington State.
abstract.textZh: 在華盛頓州的一個大型初級保健醫療系統中進行了一次橫斷面調查。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Out of 243 emerging adult respondents, 136 (56%) reported experiencing loneliness. Bivariate analyses showed no significant difference for racial/ethnic minorities, while women and nonbinary individuals were significantly lonelier than men (P = 0.03), sexual and gender minority (SGM) groups were lonelier than heterosexuals (P < 0.01) and single individuals were lonelier than those in a relationship (P = 0.02). In a logistic regression model (R2 = 0.11), SGM individuals had OR = 2.01 of loneliness compared to heterosexuals (95% CI = 1.09-3.75; P = 0.03) and individuals in a relationship had OR = 0.37 compared to single individuals (95% CI = 0.20-0.66; P < 0.01).

abstract.label: DISCUSSION
abstract.text: These findings show that it is feasible to identify emerging adults with loneliness and demonstrate the need for targeted loneliness interventions in primary care settings to reduce health disparities among this demographic group.

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence for Diagnosing Images of Common Skin Disorders
articles.authors: von Kuenssberg Jehle D, Browne MK, Hoffmann HP, Paul KK, Talbott MM, Campbell KM, Linfante AW, Sorensen BA, et al.

abstract.label: INTRODUCTION
abstract.text: Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning are increasingly used in dermatology, primarily for diagnosing skin cancer and classifying disease severity. Primary care providers (PCPs) and emergency physicians have higher error rates in diagnosing dermatologic conditions compared to dermatologists. This study evaluates the performance of an AI-driven dermatologic image analytics tool in identifying common skin disorders from classical images used in medical education.
abstract.textZh: 人工智慧（ AI ）和機器學習越來越多地用於皮膚科，主要用於診斷皮膚癌和分類疾病嚴重程度。與皮膚科醫生相比，初級保健提供者（ PCP ）和急診醫生在診斷皮膚病方面的錯誤率更高。本研究評估了AI驅動的皮膚圖像分析工具在從醫學教育中使用的經典圖像中識別常見皮膚疾病方面的表現。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This prospective study analyzed 42 classical images of common skin disorders using the bellePro application (version 2.1.0; BelleTorus Corporation), trained on over 400,000 dermatologic images. A set of dermatologic images used in a national board review course underwent blinding and independent validation by an academic dermatology department. This module provides AI-powered predictions from cell phone photos, ranking them by "image match scores" (higher values indicate better predictions). The primary outcome was the accuracy of three image predictions in identifying known diagnoses, along with the corresponding image match scores.
abstract.textZh: 這項前瞻性研究使用bellePro應用程式（版本2.1.0 ； BelleTorus Corporation ）分析了42張常見皮膚病的經典影像，該應用程式針對超過400,000張皮膚病影像進行了培訓。在國家委員會審查課程中使用的一組皮膚科影像經過學術皮膚科的致盲和獨立驗證。本模組提供手機相片的人工智能預測，根據「圖像匹配分數」進行排名（數值越高表示預測越好）。主要結果是三個圖像預測在識別已知診斷方面的準確性，以及相應的圖像匹配分數。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The AI tool correctly predicted 38 out of 42 skin disorders (positive predictive value was 90.5%) as the top differential on the first attempt for all three attempts. Four conditions (angioedema, squamous cell carcinoma, hand foot and mouth disease, and chickenpox) were included in the prediction differential list each attempt but never ranked first, bringing the total to 42/42 (100%). None of the correctly identified disorders had an average image match score below 0.64. The average image match score for correct diagnoses was 0.896 (SD = 0.098).
abstract.textZh: AI工具正確地預測了42種皮膚疾病中的38種（陽性預測值為90.5 ％ ） ，作為所有三次嘗試的第一次嘗試的最高差異。每次嘗試都將四種疾病（血管性水腫、鱗狀細胞癌、手足口病和水痘）納入預測差異列表，但從未排在第一位，使總數達到42/42 （ 100% ）。沒有正確識別的疾病的平均影像匹配分數低於0.64。正確診斷的平均影像匹配分數為0.896 （ SD = 0.098 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: The findings suggest that this AI-based dermatologic image analytics tool performs effectively on classical images of common skin disorders typically seen in clinical practice. This has potential to serve as an adjunct for providers to improve patient outcomes in environments lacking timely access to dermatology resources.
abstract.textZh: 研究結果表明，這種基於AI的皮膚圖像分析工具可以有效地對臨牀實踐中常見的常見皮膚病的經典圖像進行分析。這有可能作為提供者的輔助手段，在無法及時獲得皮膚科資源的環境中改善患者的結果。

articles.title: The Future of Patient Panel Size in Primary Care
articles.authors: Strayer SM, Hoff T

abstract.text: Britz et al present an important contribution to the understanding of primary care capacity by identifying all Primary Care Physicians (PCPs) in one state and quantifying their patient panel sizes. Their findings, showing median panels between 1196 and 1290 patients, provide critical insight into how many individuals each PCP can realistically serve amid a national primary care shortage. This commentary explores emerging trends that may reshape how ideal panel size is defined in the future, particularly the increasing integration of non-physician providers, digital health platforms, and artificial intelligence (AI) tools. Technologies such as ambient dictation, automated order entry, and AI-driven patient messaging can reclaim valuable clinician time and help mitigate burnout, potentially allowing physicians to manage larger panels. Likewise, wearable sensors, virtual visits, and non-traditional care outlets such as retail clinics and urgent care centers offer additional opportunities to expand system-wide capacity. However, these efficiencies must be balanced against current capacity issues in primary care, including potential added monitoring workload, increasing complexity of patients, as well as currently over-burdened primary care practices due to administrative burden and high volumes of patient messaging. Future studies are needed to determine whether these innovations truly expand capacity or simply redistribute effort within the evolving ecosystem of primary care.
abstract.textZh: Britz等人通過確定一個州的所有初級保健醫生（ PCP ）並量化其患者面板大小，為理解初級保健能力做出了重要貢獻。 他們的研究結果顯示了1196至1290名患者的中位數，為在國家初級保健短缺的情況下，每個PCP可以實際服務多少人提供了關鍵的見解。 本評論探討可能重塑未來理想面板尺寸定義的新興趨勢，特別是非醫師提供者、數位健康平臺和人工智能（ AI ）工具的整合日益增加。 環境聽寫、自動訂單輸入和AI驅動的患者消息傳遞等技術可以回收寶貴的臨牀醫生時間，並有助於減輕過勞，從而可能允許醫生管理更大的面板。 同樣，可穿戴式感測器、虛擬就診以及零售診所和緊急護理中心等非傳統護理網點也為擴大全系統容量提供了額外的機會。 然而，這些效率必須與初級護理目前的容量問題相平衡，包括潛在的監測工作量增加、患者日益複雜，以及由於行政負擔和患者訊息量大，目前初級護理實踐負擔過重。 未來的研究需要確定這些創新是否真正擴大了容量，或者只是在不斷發展的初級保健生態系統中重新分配工作。

articles.title: Association of Asynchronous Virtual Scribe Services: Patient Experience in Primary Care
articles.authors: Stephens J, Biery N, Kieber-Emmons A, Hamadani R, Allen N, Greenberg G

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Virtual scribe services are increasingly utilized to reduce documentation burden and mitigate clinician burnout. While evidence supports their positive impact on clinician wellness and productivity, the effect on patient experience has not received as much attention. We hypothesized that clinicians using virtual scribes would demonstrate improved patient satisfaction scores due to enhanced face-to-face interaction during visits.
abstract.textZh: 越來越多地使用虛擬抄寫員服務來減輕文件負擔並減輕臨牀醫生過勞。雖然有證據支持它們對臨牀醫生的健康和生產力的積極影響，但對患者體驗的影響卻沒有受到那麼多的關注。我們假設使用虛擬抄寫員的臨牀醫生會在訪問期間通過增強面對面互動來提高患者滿意度分數。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: Using a pre-post design, we analyzed patient satisfaction data for 81 primary care clinicians utilizing asynchronous virtual scribe services (two different vendor programs) within a large integrated health network in Eastern Pennsylvania. Patient satisfaction was measured using four vendor-administered questions assessing overall rating of care, likelihood to recommend, clinician listening, and trust. Pre-implementation scores (6 months prior to scribe utilization) were compared to post-implementation scores (months 3-9 with a scribe service) using related-samples Wilcoxon signed-rank tests.
abstract.textZh: 我們使用事前設計，在賓夕法尼亞州東部的大型綜合健康網絡中，利用異步虛擬抄寫服務（兩個不同的供應商計劃）分析了81名初級保健臨牀醫生的患者滿意度數據。使用四個供應商管理的問題來衡量患者滿意度，評估整體護理評分、推薦的可能性、臨牀醫生聆聽和信任。使用相關樣本Wilcoxon簽署等級測試，將實施前評分（抄寫員使用前6個月）與實施後評分（使用抄寫員服務的3-9個月）進行比較。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Statistically significant improvements in patient-reported satisfaction metrics were observed in overall rating of the visit (P < .001) and trust (P = .012). Likelihood to recommend and listening showed positive trends but did not reach statistical significance (P = .086 and P = .705, respectively).
abstract.textZh: 在回診（ P < 0.001 ）和信任（ P = 0.012 ）的整體評分中，觀察到患者報告滿意度指標的統計學顯著改善。推薦和聆聽的可能性顯示出積極的趨勢，但未達到統計顯著性（分別為P = 0.086和P = 0.705 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Virtual scribe implementation was associated with significant improvements in patient-reported overall experience and trust in their clinicians. These findings suggest that reducing documentation burden may enhance the patient-clinician relationship, providing additional justification for scribe investment beyond clinician wellness.

articles.title: Billing Medicaid for Community Health Worker Services: The Promise, Pitfalls, and Path Forward
articles.authors: Sanders MR, Fiscella K

abstract.text: This commentary examines the implications of the Community Health Worker (CHW) Access Act introduced by Congress. If passed, primary care practices would be able to receive reimbursement for CHW services. CHWs are lay members of the community that help people address the social determinants of health, understand their health, and get the health care they need, especially in communities where resources are scarce. They have been shown to improve health outcomes, yet many serve in unpaid positions and their services have not been readily reimbursable in the healthcare system. We highlight the potential of the Bill to facilitate the uptake of CHWs in primary care. This is particularly important at a time when the provision of primary care is scarce. We examine the potential and pitfalls of the Bill and recommend implementation strategies to support the uptake of CHWs into primary care. This commentary aims to inform stakeholders about the Bill's broader impact on primary care and future CHW sustainability.
abstract.textZh: 本評論審查了國會提出的《社區衛生工作者（ CHW ）準入法》的含義。 如果通過，初級保健實踐將能夠獲得CHW服務的報銷。 CHW是社區的平民成員，幫助人們解決健康的社會決定因素，了解他們的健康狀況，並獲得所需的醫療保健，特別是在資源稀缺的社區。 它們已被證明可以改善健康結果，但許多人擔任無薪職位，他們的服務在醫療保健系統中並不容易獲得報銷。 我們強調該法案在促進初級保健領域吸收CHW方面的潛力。 在初級護理很少的時候，這一點尤其重要。 我們研究該法案的潛力和陷阱，並建議實施策略，以支持CHW進入初級保健。 本評論旨在告知利益相關者該法案對初級保健和未來CHW可持續性的更廣泛影響。
